title: Appoint a director for a Welsh jurisdiction company (AP01c)
text:
You can file this form if your company’s jurisdiction is ‘Wales’ (instead of ‘England and Wales’). The form is bilingual in Welsh and English.

 If your company’s jurisdiction is not Wales, file a form AP01 .

 It is easier and quicker to file online .

 If the company is in the Protected online filing (PROOF) Scheme , you need to file online.

 Chrome users may not be able to view checkboxes on printed versions of this form. You should use another browser or file this document online.

 If you’re filing on paper, you need to print the form at full size on white A4 sized paper.
